title: staphylodendron pinnatum
intro: Staphylodendron pinnatum, commonly known as the "Pine Cone Bush" or "Pine Bush", is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of S. pinnatum include reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
